days.label: Advent week 1 — Hope
days.readingNote: As you read today, watch for promises that point toward a coming Savior.
days.devotionalNote: Light one candle (real or drawn) and name one hope your family is waiting on with God.
days.prayerNote: Pray for neighbors who need hope this season.

days.label: Advent week 2 — Peace
days.readingNote: Notice where God brings peace in the middle of busy or hard stories.
days.devotionalNote: Ask: Where did we feel rushed today? Where can we invite God's peace?
days.prayerNote: Pray peace over one relationship in your home.

days.label: Advent week 3 — Joy
days.readingNote: Look for reasons to rejoice — even small ones — in today's passages.
days.devotionalNote: Share one joy from this week, no matter how small.
days.prayerNote: Thank God aloud for three gifts before bedtime.

days.label: Advent week 4 — Love
days.readingNote: Watch for how God's love shows up for ordinary people.
days.devotionalNote: Do one quiet act of love for someone in your family before the day ends.
days.prayerNote: Pray that your home would be a place of welcome and love.
